en: Colorized panoramic view of a small town with red-roofed houses nestled in a forested valley surrounded by high mountains. A prominent church with a tall bell tower and red roof stands on the right side above the town. At the top center, text labels a mountain peak as "PIZZO DI LEVICO". At the bottom right, cursive text reads "Roncegno m. 550 - Panorama". The overall style and colorization resemble a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.
